parts:
I think that presentation is quite out-dated (fixme), as it seems was created in 2005.
You might rather use `RFileHandler` instead to source a file's content, but see the docs for more details: http://rapache.net/manual.html

Best,
Gergely

On Fri, Dec 21, 2012 at 11:48 AM, Priyadarshan Raj <darshan...@gmail.com> wrote:
hi all,

I recently starting working on R..I am going through the tutorials for web app development using rApache(http://biostat.mc.vanderbilt.edu/wiki/pub/Main/RApacheProject/presentation.pdf)...

I edited my httpd.conf file by adding the following lines in it :-

<Location /test/hello>
        SetHandler r-handler
        Rsource /var/www/html/test.R
        RreqHandler handler
</Location>

I also kept my test.R file in the location  /var/www/html/test.R..

when i restarted the server using the command "service httpd restart"

I am getting the following errors :-

Stopping httpd:                                            [  OK  ]
Starting httpd: Syntax error on line 1017 of /etc/httpd/conf/httpd.conf:
Invalid command 'Rsource', perhaps misspelled or defined by a module not included in the server configuration
                                                           [FAILED]

I also tried to google  which module to load  "Rsource"..but unable to find it..please help..

messages.subject: Re: Web app development using R
parts:
You should really check out that documentation and maybe a more up-to-date demo application.
That's pretty normal that you get no errors and no results, as you only declare a function in the file what is called and that's it.
For a quick success, place only this in your R file:

cat('Hello World!')

Or I ate too much Christmas pie and really miss something obvious here :)

Best,
Gergely

</Location>

and my test.R file is as follows :-

apache.write(r,"<h1>Hello World!</h1>")
OK

When i restarted my server.I am not getting any error on restarting the server.But when i am redirecting to the url
